markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (91%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Resampled simulated frozen section is 100% out-of-distribution (44% reliability), models disagree, and margins defer to permanent sections [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 91%, Invasive 7%, Benign 2%, Normal 0% [F1] | Low invasive carcinoma risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% coverage (alpha 10%) | Single class; 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged), 100% OOD [F6] | Flagged degraded input; AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%), 2/5 Benign [F5] | Mixed neighbors; closest is Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Below-typical score (+0.36 push toward invasive; 8/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Typical score pushes away from invasive (-0.30; 19/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Pushes toward invasive (+0.30), but 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 5) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score pushes away from invasive (-0.17; 12/20 AI spot check) · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score pushes away from invasive (-0.14; 18/20 AI spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top-risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Resampling degradation (severity 3) obscures stromal invasion in high-risk regions 2 (84%), 7 (83%), 8 (68%), or 9 (65%).
- Lesion is Benign like closest match BACH_0330 (83% similarity), where CONCH and MUSK disagree on top class.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 7, 8, 9**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (65%–84% risk) and region 8 for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus artifact; review drafted recut H&E and deeper-level orders.
3. **Regions 0–3, 7, 8, 11**: Defer surgical margin call to permanent sections on this degraded frozen section.
